notes:
Short CRM-style notes and POC details:
- Customer: mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics + support layer). Primary product integrates an in-app help assistant and contextual doc search.
- Hosted trial summary (10/10 - 11/30): observed baseline QPS ~3.2, peak QPS ~18 (15-minute spike), average concurrency seen at peak ~12. Token mix recorded during trial: ~70% short (<50 tokens), ~25% medium (50-512 tokens), ~5% long (>512 tokens). Average tokens per request: ~210. Monthly extrapolated tokens (trial -> monthly) ~150M tokens.
- Latency: p50 ~95ms, p95 ~320ms on Hosted API region us-west; customer target p95 <=250ms for chat flows.
- Cost sensitivity: finance wants expected unit costs that keep monthly inference spend < $12k for pilot, <$45k for 1.0 scale.
- POC success criteria: 1) chat p95 <300ms for 95% of requests, 2) embeddings throughput >=400 qps for search workflow, 3) reranker accuracy within 3% of hosted baseline, 4) predictable monthly spend within quoted estimate.
- Dedicated asks: estimate steady-state QPS 8 with 30 concurrency headroom for orchestration + bursts up to 40 QPS. Request 2x headroom for peak planning. Preferred autoscale policy: 1 base pool + burst pool; warm standby. Interested in A100/H100-backed Dedicated nodes; open to quantized variants if latency meets SLO.
- Operational needs: prefix/KV caching for repeated user contexts, token-based tracing, per-route cost breakdown, rollout canary for 10% of traffic. Need KMS integration + audit logging for all token payloads.
- Routing/fallback: prefer same-model fallback first, then smaller quantized model; require transparent error counts and automatic fallback policy.
- Quote ask: 12-month reserved Dedicated plan with 6mo ramp; finance asked for a month-by-month burn forecast and model variant pricing breakouts.
- Security: must have SSO/SAML for admin console, retention controls for transcripts (90d default), ability to commit to EU region residency for EU customers (future requirement).
- Direct quote from CTO on call (11/12): "We need predictable latency and a price we can model into our SaaS tiers — if Dedicated gives stable numbers, we can commit to an annual purchase."
- AE notes: prioritize SOC2 artifacts and a clear dedicated sizing worksheet that maps QPS + token mix -> GPU count and expected token/sec capacity. SE to produce two sizing scenarios (conservative and aggressive).
- Known risks: legal DPA delay, procurement wanting cloud-resident-only option, potential objections about minimum committed spend.
technical_summary: Hosted trial provided real telemetry used to build Dedicated sizing. Trial-derived forecast inputs: observed avg QPS 3.2, peak QPS 18, typical concurrency 6-12, average tokens/request 210, token distribution short/medium/long = 70/25/5. Customer requests Dedicated plan for steady 8 QPS with burst to 40 QPS and 2x headroom. SE recommended two configs: (A) 2x A100 nodes with autoscale for bursts (conservative), (B) 1x H100 + 1x quantized A100 for mixed workloads (cost-optimized). Expected monthly tokens at 1.0 scale ~150M-400M depending on feature uptake. P95 latency SLO target 250ms (customer insist).
pricing_notes: Finance wants per-token ceilings and a committed monthly spend < $45k at GA. AE to propose 12-month contract with a blended rate: hosted-equivalent during trial -> dedicated reserved discount (ask: 20-35% off metered). Also requested per-model tier pricing and overage rules. SE added estimated infra footprint and asked for two pricing bands (50k ARR pilot, 150k ARR production).
